name: GBM meta-score + fair-threshold blend
tagline: Gradient-boosted correctness predictor on enriched confidence/group/X features, then per-group thresholds blended with global by α∈[0,1] minimizing a joint coverage-bounded fairness objective.
diff_from_baseline: Replaces learned-deferral baseline's logistic gate with a GBM meta-model on richer nonlinear features, and replaces groupwise-thresholding's plain per-group quantiles with a global↔per-group blend selected by a fairness-regularized joint objective subject to a hard coverage band.

name: Logistic gate + iterative fair thresholds
tagline: Same logistic correctness predictor as learned-deferral, then a greedy iterative scheme that shifts the most/least-deferring groups' thresholds to shrink the deferral-rate gap under a coverage tolerance.
init_recovers: Learned-deferral baseline at iteration 0 (per-group quantiles only)
diff_from_baseline: Layers on top of learned-deferral baseline a fairness post-processing loop that explicitly shrinks deferral-rate gap (where groupwise-thresholding baseline only sets per-group quantiles without any gap-aware adjustment) while keeping coverage within tolerance.

name: DRO-weighted GBM + Pareto threshold mix
tagline: Group-DRO inverse-frequency reweighted gradient-boosting meta-classifier with cross-val OOF scores; per-group thresholds set by mixing target coverage with each group's coverage at the global threshold (λ-sweep optimizes worst-group risk).

key_hyperparams.name: CV folds
key_hyperparams.role: OOF predictions to avoid score leakage

diff_from_baseline: Differs from learned-deferral by using a DRO-weighted GBM (with cross-val OOF scoring to remove leakage), and from groupwise-thresholding by parametrizing per-group target coverages along a single $\lambda$ axis chosen to minimize a worst-group-risk + 5×def-gap + overall-risk objective.

name: Mixed score + Bayesian group offset
tagline: Convex blend of base max-prob and a logistic correctness gate, modulated by margin/entropy, with empirical-Bayes per-group additive offsets and a 0.65/0.35 blend of global vs per-group quantile thresholds.

key_hyperparams.name: mix_weight w
key_hyperparams.role: convex weight on logistic meta-score vs max-prob

diff_from_baseline: Unlike learned-deferral (pure logistic) and groupwise-thresholding (pure per-group quantile), it blends both at the score level (max-prob ⊕ logistic) AND threshold level (global ⊕ per-group), and adds a Bayesian-shrunk per-group score offset based on calibration residuals.

name: LR+GB ensemble + density-aware fair tweak
tagline: Average of LR and GBM correctness scores as the meta gate; per-group quantile thresholds shrunk toward global, then iteratively nudged using local density to meet per-group acceptance ≈ target.

key_hyperparams.name: ensemble mix
key_hyperparams.role: weight of LR vs GBM scores

key_hyperparams.name: shrinkage cap
key_hyperparams.role: max λ for per-group threshold shrinkage

diff_from_baseline: Differs from learned-deferral (single logistic) by stacking LR and GBM correctness predictors, and from groupwise-thresholding by adding empirical-Bayes shrinkage of per-group thresholds plus an iterative density-aware Newton-like nudge to align per-group acceptance with the target coverage.
